baseline.baseline_reproducibility: Git commit and peeled annotated tag target verified against local, origin and GitHub references.

release_objective: QF Solver 0.2.12 is a bounded A+NL release: reduced linear structural dynamics, richer excitation channels, and targeted consolidation of existing nonlinear-static behavior. V&V is targeted to changed and new capability scopes, not a global solver requalification campaign.

core_work_packages.name: Nonlinear accepted states / checkpoint migration / convergence

options.name: Residual flexibility
options.selection_rule: May be separately authorized after its interface, cost and targeted evidence are reviewed. Its omission cannot block the 0.2.12 core.

dynamic_initial_domain.discrete_entities: admissible concentrated masses and springs attached to existing supported structural DOFs; entity ownership/preflight must be explicit
dynamic_initial_domain.operator_domain: reduced M and K must satisfy the positive-definite domain contracted for the selected method; unsupported massless directions fail closed
dynamic_initial_domain.compatibility_rule: A new method rejecting an unsupported model must not make a previously compatible legacy route reject it.

nonlinear_initial_domain.intent: consolidate existing nonlinear-static routes and their semantics; no new constitutive family
priorities: corotational J2 stress measure labels and transformations
numerical tangent robustness and origin invariance
explicit method- and scope-dependent support matrix

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: explicit, unit-resolved force phasors/time histories and uniform base-motion inputs with stable excitation identity
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: force channels and uniform translational base acceleration only; no implicit grid, unit, phase, sign or frame inference
method_scope_matrix.DAMPING_SCOPE: excitation definition is separate from damping; compatibility is owned by the consuming method contract
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: resolved channel identity and complex phasor or time-history provenance; response values belong to the consuming analysis

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: assemble/prepare reduced structural M, K and explicit excitation operators; internal prerequisite, not a standalone qualification claim
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: contracted force and base-motion channels only; WP03 owns channel semantics
method_scope_matrix.DAMPING_SCOPE: no implicit damping matrix; WP01 must define supported damping inputs and method compatibility
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: prepared operator identity and diagnostics; public result exposure decided in WP01/WP11

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: real symmetric generalized eigenproblem for the prepared reduced M/K, with contracted mode normalization and cluster/truncation policy
method_scope_matrix.DAMPING_SCOPE: basis is undamped; damping assignment is a separate explicit model contract
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: eigenvalues, modes, residuals, cluster/truncation diagnostics subject to WP01/WP11 availability contract

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: reduced modal superposition plus explicit direct-reference comparison only where damping/operator assumptions are compatible
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: contracted force phasors and, if WP07 permits, uniform base-acceleration phasors
method_scope_matrix.DAMPING_SCOPE: only WP01-contracted modal damping; modal damping does not imply a complete physical C; full-basis/direct equivalence is conditional, not presumed
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: complex displacement/response phasors and availability diagnostics; reactions may be unavailable under modal damping

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: modal Newmark integration on the contracted reduced basis; legacy direct Newmark route remains separately preserved
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: contracted force histories and uniform base acceleration if WP07 passes its separate gate
method_scope_matrix.DAMPING_SCOPE: only explicit WP01-contracted modal damping; no inferred physical damping matrix
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: time histories, selected modal/generalized quantities and checkpoint availability as declared by WP01/WP11

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: equivalent inertial loading formed with the complete supported mass/operator model before constraint elimination; distinct relative and absolute response frames
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: uniform prescribed translational base acceleration, with axes, units, sign and input history/phasor explicit
method_scope_matrix.DAMPING_SCOPE: must follow the selected harmonic/transient method contract; reactions are explicitly availability-tagged
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: relative response and absolute response only when reconstructable; unavailable quantities must be represented as unavailable, not zero

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: residual-flexibility correction to reduced harmonic response
ELEMENT_FAMILY: same as the qualified reduced dynamic domain; no broadened family
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: same explicit channels as core harmonic response
method_scope_matrix.DAMPING_SCOPE: only if mathematically compatible with WP01 damping contract
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: separately contracted corrected response and residual diagnostics
method_scope_matrix.QUALIFICATION_TARGET: independent option gate; does not gate core G03/G04

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: targeted correction/migration of corotational J2 stress measure identity and public labels
method_scope_matrix.ELEMENT_FAMILY: existing nonlinear-static families only; exact method/family support is recorded, not broadened, in WP01/WP08
method_scope_matrix.MATERIAL_SCOPE: existing corotational J2 scope only; no new constitutive model
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: static loads already supported by the selected legacy route
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: each stress measure and migration outcome explicit; ambiguous legacy semantics fail closed

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: robustness and provenance of existing corotational finite-difference tangent, including raw and symmetrized forms
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: raw tangent, returned tangent, step policy and diagnostic comparison available to the targeted evidence contract

method_scope_matrix.METHOD: accepted-state, convergence/failure reporting and fail-closed v1-to-v2 checkpoint migration
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: existing static loads and continuation state only
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: accepted state and checkpoint compatibility are explicit; unsafe legacy state is refused, never silently promoted

method_scope_matrix.MATERIAL_SCOPE: nonlinear, anisotropic or otherwise uncontracted material behavior
method_scope_matrix.EXCITATION_SCOPE: contact, follower, unsupported spatially varying or nonlinear excitation
method_scope_matrix.RESULT_AVAILABILITY: explicit refusal with reason; no partial result presented as valid

inherited_technical_findings.note: Prepared operator identity must distinguish physical model, operator and excitation; do not use an incomplete nominal signature.
A legacy checkpoint case cannot be migrated unless the required state and identity are provable; ambiguous/incomplete cases must fail closed.
Evidence must compare raw numerical tangent and returned/symmetrized tangent; symmetrization must not hide a defect.
Current finite-difference step depends on max(abs(coords)); investigate objective length/scale measures without changing the formulation silently.

reference_dag.interpretation: WP03/WP04 may proceed after their shared contracts and prepared-system interface are frozen; no downstream numerical work starts before its prerequisite WP exits.

release_gates.name: Baseline / scope
release_gates.pass: All WP00 acceptance items are evidenced; scope changes require explicit Owner approval.
release_gates.fail: Baseline mismatch, unresolved scope conflict, stale current authority left uncorrected, or historical record rewritten.
release_gates.blocking: Blocks all implementation WPs until PASS.
evidence: exact Git refs and validation output

release_gates.name: Architecture / identities
release_gates.pass: Interfaces and identity rules are versioned, deterministic and fail closed before numerical implementation.
release_gates.fail: Ambiguous identity, inferred damping/reactions, unsafe resume or implicit legacy maturity.

release_gates.name: Formulations
checks: DYN operator, modal reduction, excitation and base-acceleration equations
NL stress measure definitions, raw/returned tangent semantics, checkpoint state meaning
release_gates.pass: DYN and NL each independently pass their formulation tests; no aggregate PASS can hide a failing axis.
release_gates.fail: Either DYN or NL has a formulation defect or unsupported scope is silently accepted.
release_gates.blocking: Blocks only the affected track and dependent integration; release core cannot claim the failed track.

release_gates.name: Numerical behavior
checks: DYN residuals, modal clusters, reduced/direct comparisons where assumptions permit, time/frequency response
release_gates.pass: Each axis meets its preregistered numerical and failure-mode criteria; any ambiguity remains visible.
release_gates.fail: A required metric fails, threshold changes post hoc, or a failure is hidden by another axis.
release_gates.blocking: Blocks claims and release of the affected capability; no automatic maturity promotion.

release_gates.name: Non-regression / interfaces
checks: legacy checkpoint readers and fail-closed migration
release_gates.pass: No unapproved regression; availability changes are explicit; legacy-compatible inputs remain compatible.
release_gates.fail: Any unexplained legacy numerical/API change or silent data loss.
release_gates.blocking: Blocks merge of affected WP and candidate freeze.
evidence: targeted non-regression results on exact candidate SHA

release_gates.name: Candidate / audit
release_gates.pass: Candidate and exact selected artifacts pass all bound release checks; historical archive clearance remains separate.
release_gates.fail: Any identity/hash mismatch, missing proof, unapproved payload or misleading claim.

release_gates.name: Publication
release_gates.pass: Only authorized selected artifacts are published and independently re-downloaded/hash-verified; no whole-repository clearance is implied.
release_gates.fail: Any remote mismatch, unselected archive upload, missing Owner authorization or inaccurate maturity/claim.

preserved_non_regression_surfaces: Existing linear static routes and their contracted element/material combinations.
Existing direct modal, harmonic and Newmark routes; no replacement or implicit routing to the new reduced methods.
Existing mass/spring assembly and boundary-condition reduction for inputs already supported.
Existing nonlinear-static constitutive and contact behavior outside explicitly authorized WP08-WP10 changes.
Existing result/serialization readers and explicitly supported checkpoint schemas; unsafe migrations must refuse rather than corrupt or silently reinterpret state.
Existing API, CLI, package imports and public documentation outside approved versioned edits.

wp01_boundary.allowed_in_wp01: Design, schema/contracts, compatibility policy and contract tests only; no numerical operator, solver, stress, tangent, excitation or result-producing implementation.
prohibited_in_wp01: changes to v0.2.11 history or artifacts
wp01_boundary.exit_condition: Every listed contract has a versioned definition, positive and negative tests, explicit compatibility behavior, and no unresolved choice that numerical WPs would otherwise invent.
